title: Max Area of Island
summary: Find the largest number of land cells in a single island.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–50 rows and 1–50 columns. The grid is rectangular and contains only integer 0 and 1 values.

statement: Find the largest number of land cells in a single island. Land is 1 and water is 0. Two land cells belong to the same island when they can reach each other through land using shared edges. Return zero if there is no land.

examples.explanation: The adjacent pair is larger than the isolated cell.
There is no land to count.

constraints: 1–50 rows and 1–50 columns. The grid is rectangular and contains only integer 0 and 1 values.
hints: Conceptual: An island's area depends on all its reachable cells.
Directional: Start a flood fill at every land cell that has not been visited.
Implementation: Mark cells when you add them to the worklist, count each once, and keep the largest completed count.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(mn) auxiliary space with iterative flood fill and separate visit marks.
